name: labs/xylophoneengine__pycss45
title: Gigahertz-Optik CSS45 spectral sensor (pycss45.CSS45)
intro: Gigahertz-Optik CSS45 spectral sensor (pycss45.CSS45), adapted from xylophoneengine/pycss45. It reads `serial_number`, `firmware_version`, `status`, `temperature` and 7 more; runs `measure_spectrum`. `measure_spectrum`: acquire an optical or mass spectrum over a declared wavelength or mass range and return the axis and intensity arrays, or an artifact reference for large spectra. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
